title: EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams
abstract: arXiv:2610.39813v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on collaboration among specialized agents to solve complex tasks. Existing methods improve MAS by refining the prompts, skills, and execution strategies of individual agents based on task feedback. However, improving individual agents does not necessarily lead to better team collaboration. Recent studies have therefore extended evolution to the collaboration level, using collective execution experience to adjust team organization, and inter-agent interactions. Nevertheless, evolving collaboration across heterogeneous tasks remains challenging, as existing approaches often constrain team reorganization within a shared structure and reuse interaction rules across incompatible team contexts. In this paper, we propose EvoTeam, a collaboration-centric evolution framework that jointly evolves team organization, interaction rules, and individual agent skills through execution experience. translated_title: EvoTeam：基于团队进化的多智能体协作
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）依靠专业化智能体之间的协作来解决复杂任务。现有方法通过基于任务反馈优化单个智能体的提示词、技能和执行策略来改进MAS。然而，提升单个智能体的能力并不一定能带来更好的团队协作。因此，近期的研究将进化扩展到协作层面，利用集体执行经验来调整团队组织和智能体间的交互。尽管如此，在异构任务中进化协作仍然具有挑战性，因为现有方法往往将团队重组限制在共享结构内，并在不兼容的团队上下文中复用交互规则。本文提出了EvoTeam，这是一个以协作为中心的进化框架，通过执行经验共同进化团队组织、交互规则和单个智能体的技能。它维护了一……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: EvoTeam提出了一种以协作为中心的进化框架，通过执行经验联合进化团队组织、交互规则和智能体技能，克服了现有方法在异构任务中团队重组受限、交互规则跨上下文复用不当的局限。
en_tdlr: EvoTeam proposes a collaboration-centric evolution framework that jointly evolves team organization, interaction rules, and agent skills from execution experience, overcoming existing limitations where team reorganization is confined to shared structures and interaction rules are reused across incompatible team contexts.
